browser_observations: Flight is visibly airborne, tucks all four legs, alternates broad upstroke and downstroke silhouettes, and uses neck and tail stabilization.
Walk alternates diagonal leg fields with torso weight shift, head counter-motion and tail counter-sweep.
Strike combines preparation, neck extension, wing stabilization and recovery; translation supplements rather than replaces regional deformation.
Environment illumination plus key/fill/rim lights keep scales, feather layering, horns and limb connections readable throughout the reviewed turn.
